An edition of the '''Great Hunt''' was held<ref name="Holonet" /><ref name="TOR:TMS" /> around [[3660 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> during the [[Great Galactic War]].<ref name="TOR:TMS" /> The Hunt was instigated by [[Mandalore the Lesser]] to inspire and unite the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] following their humiliating [[Battle on the Hydian Way|defeat]] during the [[Blockade of the Hydian Way]]. The competition ended with the victory of [[Mandalore the Vindicated|Artus Lok]],<ref name="Holonet" /><ref name="TOR:TMS" /> who promptly challenged the current Mandalore to a duel.<ref name="Holonet" /> Artus [[Death/Legends|killed]] Mandalore the Lesser and claimed the title as Mandalore the Vindicated.<ref name="Holonet" /><ref name="TOR:TMS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Although [[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia|''The Old Republic Encyclopedia'']] presented the Great Hunt won by Mandalore the Vindicated as a consequence of the [[Treaty of Coruscant]],<ref name="TORE">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref> [[Star Wars: The Old Republic|''The Old Republic'']] video game itself and the "[[The Holonet|Holonet]]" section of its official website placed that Great Hunt after the [[Blockade of the Hydian Way]],<ref name="Holonet" /><ref name="TOR:TMS" /> seven years earlier.<ref name="Timeline2">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 2: The Mandalorian Blockade is Broken|int=Timeline 2: The Mandalorian Blockade is Broken}}</ref> [[The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural (real-life book)|''The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural'']] also placed the rise of Mandalore the Vindicated just after the end of the Blockade of the Hydian Way.<ref name="TJoMGD">[[The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural (real-life book)|''The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural'']]</ref>
